snippet.title: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times - Official Randomizer Update Trailer | Women-Led Games 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Randomizer Update Launch Trailer for Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times, a mystery puzzle Metroidvania developed by SlugGlove. Players will transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world through puzzle-solving. Access the new randomizer mode, adding in a bunch of new options, with the Randomizer Update for Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times, available now for PC (Steam).
